newsitem.title: USA: S&P raises NYC Muni Assistance Corp ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises NYC Muni Assistance Corp ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp. on Wednesday said it upgraded the Municipal Assistance Corporation for the City of New York's ratings on first and second resolution bonds.

The agency raised 1991 first resolution bonds to AA-minus from A-plus, David Hitchcock, a rating agency analyst, told Reuters in a telephone interview. The agency also raised second resolution bond to AA from AA-minus.
Hitchcock said the upgrades reflected higher debt service coverage ratios at MAC.

Morgan Stanley & Co. on Wednesday priced and repriced a $465 million MAC bond deal amid a falling fixed income market. At the repricing, the firm raised yields in most maturities and lifted the top yield in 2008 to 5.05 percent from five percent.
